messages:
sara-sales: Hey team — need a temporary surge window for Acme POC next Fri->Sat (48h). They expect sustained ~400 RPS; current POC Dedicated pool is capped at 8 instances (roughly ~200 RPS). Can we bump autoscale/burst for the window and get a quick uplift pricing estimate? Also: customer prefers not to do full Private/VPC for the POC if avoidable. cc @kevin-se @jm-systems

jm-systems: quick facts: pool poc-acme-001 currently max_instances=8, burst_multiplier=2, min_instances=2. We can raise max_instances to 12 and burst_multiplier to 3 for a short window, or move them to a pre-warmed pool of 12. Need capacity-ops signoff for temporary quota uplift. Infra delta estimate: ~$1.1k–$1.5k/day depending on instance types.

sara-sales: ok thanks. What's the formal request flow? I can get approvals from sales leadership but want the exact CLI/portal step to avoid back-and-forth.

jm-systems: file a capacity request ticket (internal) or use the admin CLI. Example CLI to schedule change: 
/admin/pools update --pool-id poc-acme-001 --max-instances 12 --burst-mult 3 --start 2026-04-03T00:00Z --end 2026-04-05T00:00Z --reason "Acme POC surge"
Note: if the uplift >72h or becomes recurring, billing needs reserved commit or a signed PO.

kevin-se: if they don't want VPC, we can do hosted API keys scoped to the POC + IP allowlist. Also recommend enabling prefix KV caching to reduce steady-state RPS by ~25% for generation-heavy flows.

zuri-security: quick sec checklist for Dedicated surge: 1) KMS enabled for customer keys? 2) Audit log forwarding to their SIEM (or we can provide extracts) 3) IP allowlist for admin console and API keys 4) any data residency reqs?

acme-poc-cust: prefer no VPC for now, yes to IP allowlist and audit logs. They only need logs for chat generation calls, not full raw token traces.

kevin-se: sample autoscale override we plan to apply for the 48h window: 
{
  "policy": "surge-48h",
  "min_instances": 2,
  "max_instances": 12,
  "burst_multiplier": 3,
  "grace_period_sec": 300
}
This keeps latency SLOs while allowing short spikes. Will also recommend response caching on repeated prompts.

lina-account: Pricing note: for a one-off 48h uplift we'll bill at on-demand uplift rate. If they want to reserve for monthly commit we can discount — ping me and I'll run numbers. For the rough uplift: add on-demand instance-hours for +4 instances * 48h at their instance type + burst premium. I can produce a line-item estimate in 1–2h.

deploy-bot: capacity-request #CR-472 created and queued for approval (assigned: capacity-ops). ETA: approval flow 0–8h depending on load.

jm-systems: I'll open the capacity ticket now and set the timeline to pre-warm 4h before start if approved. If capacity-ops rejects, fallback is to route some traffic to hosted model variant with slightly higher latency.

sara-sales: Great. Action items: 1) lina-account -> send uplift estimate to Acme and sales leadership 2) jm-systems -> file /admin request + pre-warm plan 3) kevin-se -> prepare scoped API key + onboarding doc and caching suggestion 4) zuri-security -> confirm audit log format and minimal KMS config needed.

acme-poc-cust: thanks all — please include a short checklist for us to validate once keys are live (IP allowlist, sample log entry, SLA for the window).

jm-systems: noted. I'll post the ticket link here when created and update status.

sara-sales: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
